payload.text: ISSUE:0696 (hv decision 58): v2 banked at refs/bank/cc/0696/v2-ungated-on-0640cd65a, blob 51a8e1fcdf74, patch-id 00a960cd707a, one path, after run 1 went red on v1 (refs/bank/cc/0696/ungated-on-0640cd65a, kept). v1 put a sentinel barrier between the view's removal and its landing. That barrier is a thread ingest and renders the view back, which the arm's own comment says. v2 sets no barrier there: the landing's own wrote: line proves the view was gone, and one barrier after the landing measures the removal, the landing and a sentinel against a sentinel alone. The mechanism is unchanged: a plain write can be ingested half-written, so sentinels are renamed in whole and each measurement ends on the daemon holding its sentinel. No intentd change and no new test.
